description: A single home for the research behind SynAmp: original findings, source quality, current implementation, open questions and reproducible evidence. Start with the fast-learning report, then follow its claims into the code and experiments.
publication_boundary: The archive is preserved for research continuity. Public publication will export reviewed articles and approved assets; private operational evidence, local paths, logs and screenshots are not part of that export. No site has been published.

sections.title: Fast learning brain
sections.description: Goals become validated readings; listening signals adapt within one moment; deliberate feedback and accepted proposals can persist. Candidate values remain untuned.

sections.title: Goals, affect and memory
sections.description: Nine goal bundles, attention and lyrics, exercise/arousal, catharsis and nostalgia. Keep perceived emotion, induced effect and activity separate; source results do not establish personal outcomes.

errata.title: Original reports are historical
errata.detail: Autoclaw captures describe its frozen feature commit. Current checks belong to a separate receipt; prior counts are not current claims.

errata.title: Negative proposal acceptance
errata.detail: The original H2/brief wording promises exclusion. The code applies a bounded global thumbs-down score; maintained product copy now says lower preference.

errata.title: Memory statistic
errata.detail: Janata 2007 reports a study-specific 30% average; Janata 2009 selected participants with at least 30% in earlier validation. The maintained dossier attribution is corrected; current source access was indexed primary-text excerpts, with direct full-text opening blocked.

errata.title: Artist gate disagreement
errata.detail: A3 prose says at least two distinct tracks; P17 and epoch-v1 count events. Keep the implemented rule until a versioned decision supported by evidence.

errata.title: Dayparts and resets
errata.detail: Frozen B2 decisions/code supersede A3 daypart ranges and missing-session semantics. A reset with non-epoch scope is ignored; remove with not_now is epoch-only.

errata.title: Preliminary chapter state
errata.detail: W1 source preamble says sequencing notes are unrendered; H2 added them. W2 cites an older lab hash; final H4 capture supersedes it.

errata.title: Cross-session wording
errata.detail: Proposals are the consent channel for inferred patterns. Explicit loves, thumbs and removes can also persist at their declared scope.

errata.title: Rollback and smoke paths
errata.detail: Archived reset --hard instructions apply to its feature branch, not current main. Archived .cluster smoke paths lived outside this repository. Use the maintained follow-up and scratch route checks.

errata.title: Unsupported fields are not free
errata.detail: Declared neutral soft terms dilute score gaps and can alter bounded feedback/MMR selection. Floor normalization is neutral only within a pure bundle, apart from truncation; mixed plans reweight.

errata.title: Candidate evidence
errata.detail: Weights, bands, proposal thresholds and fixed arcs are hypotheses. Synthetic fixtures prove invariants, not classifier accuracy, usefulness or cultural generality.
